description: This file defines the MD5Crypt class, which provides methods for encrypting, decrypting, and generating random passwords using custom algorithms involving MD5 hashes and base64 encoding. It is part of the ADOdb library's session management system, specifically for cryptographic operations related to sessions.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: A class providing cryptographic methods for session data encryption, decryption, and random password generation.

methods.name: keyED
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts a string using an MD5-hashed key with a simple XOR cipher.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string with a random MD5-derived key and encodes the result with base64, using a custom XOR-based process.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string and decrypts it back to the original plaintext using the XOR-based method.

methods.name: RandPass
methods.description: Generates an 8-character random password consisting of alphanumeric characters, avoiding certain ASCII ranges.
